purpose: decide item inventory posting setup target readiness before any item or setup write

sourceBasis.finding: Item Posting Group and Inventory Posting Setup are separate setup dependencies. TARGET-046 did not unlock any item or setup write.
Visible starter accounts are 1200, 1406, 1800, 3300, 3806, 4400 and 5400. None is classified as inventory valuation / Bestand / Lagerbewertung account.
The mapping explicitly keeps Bestand / Lagerbewertung unreleased because Inventory Posting Setup needs its own article, location and valuation decision.
Inventory posting groups are assigned to item accounts through Inventory Posting Setup.
Inventory Posting Setup table 5813 contains Location Code, Invt. Posting Group Code and Inventory Account.

inventoryAccountDecision.reason: No Universaarl SKR04 starter account is currently released for inventory valuation. 5400 is Wareneingang / Materialaufwand and cannot be used as an inventory balance account without a separate source-backed decision.

locationDecision.reason: SAAR-HL is the first Universaarl warehouse/location context from the Foundation route, but it still needs to be paired with a valid inventory posting group and inventory account before setup write.

inventoryPostingGroupDecision.reason: No source-backed Inventory Posting Group code is selected. The existing general product posting candidate WAREN must not be silently reused as Inventory Posting Group.

inventoryPostingSetupKeyDecision.reason: The key is not complete until an inventory posting group code and inventory account are source-backed.

nextStepDecision.lastEvidenceSummary: TARGET-046 mapped Inventory Posting Setup as requiring Location Code, Inventory Posting Group Code and Inventory Account; TARGET-026O proves no currently released inventory valuation account.
nextStepDecision.reason: The missing SKR04 inventory account is the smallest prerequisite before an inventory posting group or Inventory Posting Setup write.

lookaheadReviewed.reason: Needed before any Inventory Posting Setup row can be written.
Needs inventory group code and inventory account decision first.
Needs group row plus inventory account before SAAR-HL combination write.
O2C still waits for item/customer posting fields, VAT setup and general posting setup boundaries.
VAT is separate from inventory posting and should not be mixed into this account-source gate.

queueChangesMade: Keep TARGET-048 as the only open next queue item.
Keep TARGET-049, TARGET-050, O2C, Preview Posting and Posting locked.
nextStepDecision.whySelectedNextCaseIsBest: It prevents using 5400 or any legacy/CRONUS inventory account as a silent inventory valuation account.
risksBeforeNextCase: Do not invent a SKR04 inventory account.
Do not derive inventory valuation from CRONUS or RM-DEMO.
Do not write Item Posting Group or Inventory Posting Setup before a source-backed account is chosen.
requiredPreparation: Check existing source registry entries for SKR04 account sources.
Use an explicit source gate for inventory valuation account candidates.
Return with either a selected candidate account or a blocked decision.
